title: Implement shared-code gated admin access + admin permission management

requirements.text: Add a shared-code gate to all Admin routes so that a signed-in user must enter the shared code "A7F9K2M8Q4R6T1Z5X3LJH9C8" to access any /admin page, even if the user already has admin permissions.

quotes: Please create a fully functional admin page that just needs a shared code to get into A7F9K2M8Q4R6T1Z5X3LJH9C8 this is the shared code also when I put the code in it will let me into the admin panel

acceptanceCriteria: When a signed-in admin visits /admin (or any /admin/* route) without having entered the shared code in the current session, they are blocked and shown a code-entry screen instead of the admin layout.
After entering the correct shared code once, the user can navigate across all /admin pages during that browser session without being prompted again.
If the code is incorrect, the user remains blocked and receives a clear error message in English.
If the user signs out, any stored admin-code verification state is cleared and the user must re-enter the shared code after signing back in.

requirements.text: Enforce the shared-code gate on the backend (not only in the UI) by adding backend APIs to: (1) verify the shared code for the caller and create a short-lived admin session marker, and (2) require that marker for all admin-only backend operations (in addition to existing admin permission checks). Include basic brute-force protection (per-caller attempt counting + temporary lockout).

quotes: they are also going to need to type in this shared code which I will provide them at the time that I promote certain accounts to admit

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an API that allows a signed-in user to submit the shared code and receive a success/fail response.
On success, the backend records an expiring admin-session marker for that caller (session expires automatically after a defined short duration, e.g. hours).

All admin-only backend methods are updated so they require BOTH: (a) the caller is an admin according to existing admin permission logic, and (b) the caller currently has a valid shared-code session marker.
After too many failed attempts (e.g., 5), the caller is locked out for a cooldown period (e.g., 5 minutes) and verification attempts return a clear failure state rather than trapping.
The shared code is not returned by any backend query and is not logged or exposed via any public API.

requirements.text: Create an Admin "Access" management page within the admin panel that allows a verified admin (admin permission + shared-code session) to grant and revoke admin access for other accounts.

quotes: I can give people admin access from there

acceptanceCriteria: A new Admin section/page exists in the /admin area for managing admin access (grant/revoke).
The page provides a way to add an admin by entering a Principal text value (and optionally selecting from a list of known users if available), and to revoke admin from an existing admin.
All grant/revoke actions call backend admin-only APIs and show success/error feedback in English.
Only a caller that is an admin AND has a valid shared-code session can access and use this page; otherwise they are blocked by the same shared-code gate/admin guard behavior as other admin pages.

requirements.text: Update the existing Admin route protection flow to incorporate the shared-code step while preserving the current Internet Identity login requirement and existing admin-permission checks.

quotes: implement this full admin page and admin system into my website! Make sure the full admin page and admin panel is complete and ready to use!

acceptanceCriteria: If the user is not signed in, admin routes still show the existing "Authentication Required" state.
If the user is signed in but is not an admin, admin routes still show the existing "Access Denied" state.

If the user is signed in and is an admin, but has not completed shared-code verification (or it expired), the UI prompts for the shared code and does not render the AdminLayout/sidebar content until verification succeeds.
After successful shared-code verification, the AdminLayout renders normally and existing admin pages remain functional.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if required to preserve/upgrade existing stable state.
Use English for all user-facing text.
Preserve the shared code exactly as provided: A7F9K2M8Q4R6T1Z5X3LJH9C8.
nonGoals: Do not remove Internet Identity authentication; users must still sign in before any admin access is possible.
Do not implement third-party authentication providers.
Do not implement real-time features (WebSockets) or external databases.
Do not expand unrelated placeholder admin sections (e.g., Stripe Setup, Social Links, etc.) unless necessary to support shared-code gating and admin access management.
